items.html: Know that another time I heard from my teacher, may his memory be blessed, that the upper Aba and Ima clothed themselves literally within the lower Yisrael Saba and Tevuna, and the gestation took place within the bowels of this Tevuna. Let us complete the first discourse, and with it this discourse too, which I wrote as I heard it another time, will be reconciled. The matter is this: know that with all the upper lights, their Reshimo always remains permanently, even after their departure. Remember this introduction.
